name: SubNav
statusNote: Alpha and little changed for years: a joined row of bordered links with an optional actions slot. Two documented props (align, full) have no implementation.
summary: A compact, segmented row of links that switch between a few related views (Labels / Milestones), with room for an action such as a search field or button at the opposite end. Choose it over UnderlineNav for a secondary, button-like switch inside a page section; choose SegmentedControl when the choice changes state rather than navigating.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: The nav landmark's accessible name (aria-label also works).

inputs.name: links
inputs.description: The links, in order: {label, href, selected}. selected marks the current view.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: Content placed at the far end of the row, vertically centred (a button, a search input).

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: A nav that lays out its body and its actions at opposite ends of one row.

anatomy.name: Body
anatomy.description: A row holding the link group and any other children, 8px apart, pulled 1px down.

anatomy.name: Link group
anatomy.description: A row of links joined edge to edge into one bordered, rounded segment.

anatomy.name: Link
anatomy.description: A segment at least 34px tall with 16px side padding, medium-weight medium body text on a 20px line, centred, with 1px --borderColor-default borders that it shares with its neighbours.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.description: The caller's actions, centred vertically at the row's end.

layout.text: The container is a flex row with space between its body and its actions; the actions centre vertically.
The body is a flex row whose children after the first sit 8px apart; it has a -1px bottom margin so the segment's bottom border can overlap a rule beneath the SubNav.
Each link is a flex box at least 34px tall, padded 16px left and right, with a hard-coded 20px line height, its text centred both ways.

Links share borders: each draws a 1px --borderColor-default top, right and bottom border, the first also a left border with medium radius on its left corners, the last medium radius on its right corners. The result is one segmented box with 1px dividers.

states.text: Links are --fgColor-default on no fill, undecorated.
Hover, and focus by any means, fill the link with --bgColor-muted, fading over 200ms ease.
Focus gets the same --bgColor-muted fill as hover; the module draws no focus ring, so the platform's default focus indicator is the only other cue.
The selected link fills --bgColor-accent-emphasis with --fgColor-onEmphasis text and turns its borders the same accent colour.

behaviour.text: Each link navigates to its href; SubNav keeps no state, and the caller sets which link is selected.
When actions are given they render after the body at the row's far end; with none, the body takes the row alone.

keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab move through the links and then the actions.
semantics: The nav is named by label or aria-label.

notes.text: align ("right") and full are documented and typed, but SubNav implements neither: both pass through to the nav element as attributes and no CSS reads them. Do not build them.
Selection is announced as aria-current="true", unlike UnderlineNav and NavList which let the caller say "page".

There is no focus-visible ring: keyboard focus looks like hover. A native build should still draw the system focus indicator (Primer's is a 2px --focus-outline-color outline) or the focused link is indistinguishable from a hovered one.
The 34px minimum height and 20px line height are marked as custom values for SubNav; the 200ms ease fade and the -1px body margin are also hard-coded.
